summaryEn: A patient with Parkinson's disease presented with severe drooling and intermittent hand tremors. Following acupuncture and herbal medicine treatment, excessive drooling ceased and hand tremors showed noticeable improvement.

A patient with Stage III bladder cancer suffering from severe lower abdominal pain received acupuncture three times weekly with herbal medicine. After five weeks of combined treatment, pain had completely resolved and the patient was able to undergo chemotherapy without difficulty.

titleEn: Supportive Care During Breast Cancer Treatment
summaryEn: A patient undergoing chemotherapy for recurrent breast cancer experienced profound fatigue. After four weeks of acupuncture twice weekly with herbal medicine, the patient reported marked improvement in energy and resumed normal daily activities.

A patient with MS experiencing frequent severe leg cramps undertook two months of acupuncture and herbal medicine. Cramp frequency and severity gradually decreased and eventually resolved, eliminating the need for high-dose magnesium supplementation.

A patient presented with upper back pain associated with asymmetrical scapular alignment. After four weeks of acupuncture twice weekly, back pain completely resolved and scapular alignment showed significant improvement.

A patient with Atrophic Vaginitis suffering from persistent vaginal pain and daily bleeding received two months of herbal medicine. Treatment resulted in complete relief from pain and significant reduction in bleeding.

A patient with Atrial Fibrillation experiencing recurrent fainting episodes received weekly acupuncture for 12 weeks. Following the course of treatment, no further episodes were reported and overall well-being improved noticeably.
